title: Extension Guide Home
desc: US federal, state, and local tax extension reference. An extension to file is not an extension to pay tax.

title: Federal Extensions Hub
desc: Every federal extension form in one place: 4868, 7004, 8868, 4768, 8809.

title: Form 4868 Individual Extension
desc: Automatic 6-month extension for Form 1040, 1040-NR, dual-status. IRC 6081, Treas. Reg. 1.6081-4.

title: Form 7004 Business Extension
desc: Automatic 6-month extension for 1120, 1120-S, 1065, 1041, 1042. Treas. Reg. 1.6081-3.

title: Form 8868 Nonprofit Extension
desc: Automatic 6-month extension for Form 990 series and Form 5330.

title: Form 4768 Estate Tax Extension
desc: Automatic filing extension and discretionary payment extension for Form 706 under IRC 6161.

title: Form 8809 Information Returns Extension
desc: Automatic 30-day extension for W-2, 1099, 1098, 1095 and other information returns. W-2 not automatic.

title: Form 5558 Employee Benefit Plan Extension
desc: One-time extension for Form 5500 series and Form 8955-SSA - automatic to the 15th day of the 3rd month after the normal due date if filed on or before that date. IRC sect 6081.

title: International Information Returns Extension Guide
desc: Forms 3520, 5471, 5472, 8621, 8854, 8865, and 8938 ride on the filer's own income tax return extension with no separate form. Form 3520-A is the exception - it requires its own Form 7004 filed under the foreign trust's own EIN, separate from the U.S. owner's own extension.

title: Special Situations
desc: Taxpayers abroad, Form 2350, combat zone relief, disaster postponements.

title: How to Paper File
desc: Timely-mailing rule, proof of mailing, Where to File addresses.

title: How to E-File
desc: IRS Free File, IRS e-file, and commercial extension services.

title: Penalties & Interest
desc: Failure-to-file, failure-to-pay, and interest rules and current rates.

title: State Extensions Hub
desc: State-by-state extension rules. California, New York, Texas, Florida, Illinois live now.

title: Interactive US Tax Extension Map
desc: Click any state for its extension rules. 15 states live, remaining states and 8 city/local jurisdictions coming soon.

title: California Tax Extension
desc: Individual and business extensions, both automatic. Cal. Code Regs. tit. 18 sect 18567; R&TC sect 18604.

title: New York Tax Extension
desc: Form IT-370 individual, Form CT-5 corporate. N.Y. Tax Law sect 657, sect 1085.

title: Texas Franchise Tax Extension
desc: No individual income tax. Form 05-164, not automatic. 34 Tex. Admin. Code sect 3.585.

title: Florida Corporate Income Tax Extension
desc: No individual income tax. Form F-7004, not automatic, 100% payment due. Fla. Stat. sect 220.222.

title: Illinois Tax Extension
desc: Individual and corporate extensions, both automatic. 35 ILCS 5/505; 86 Ill. Admin. Code sect 100.5020.

title: Pennsylvania Tax Extension
desc: Semi-automatic extension, REV-276 if tax owed. 61 Pa. Code sect 117.14.

title: New Jersey Tax Extension
desc: Form NJ-630, not automatic, 80% payment condition. N.J.A.C. 18:35-6.1.

title: Massachusetts Tax Extension
desc: Form M-4868, 80% payment condition for individuals/fiduciaries. M.G.L. c. 62C sect 19.

title: Ohio Tax Extension
desc: Fully automatic, matches federal extension, no separate form. Ohio Rev. Code sect 5747.08.

title: Washington State Tax Extension
desc: No individual or corporate income tax. B&O excise extension is discretionary. WAC 458-20-228.

title: Oregon Tax Extension
desc: Automatic with federal extension; corporations use federal Form 7004. Or. Rev. Stat. sect 314.385.

title: Georgia Tax Extension
desc: Automatic with federal extension; Form IT-303 otherwise. O.C.G.A. sect 48-7-57.

title: North Carolina Tax Extension
desc: Automatic with federal extension; Form D-410 otherwise, 90% payment rule. N.C. Gen. Stat. sect 105-263.

title: Virginia Tax Extension
desc: Automatic, no application, 90% payment rule to avoid penalty. Va. Code sect 58.1-344.

title: Michigan Tax Extension
desc: Not automatic, Form 4 plus estimated payment required. Mich. Comp. Laws sect 206.311.

title: Alabama Tax Extension
desc: Alabama automatic extension, no form, 6 months individual; federal + 1 month corporate. Ala. Code sect 40-18-27(c), sect 40-18-39(a).

title: Arizona Tax Extension
desc: Arizona 90% payment condition, 6 months individual, up to 7 corporate. A.R.S. sect 42-1107.

title: Arkansas Tax Extension
desc: Arkansas automatic with federal extension, 1 month beyond federal due date. Ark. Code Ann. sect 26-51-807.

title: Colorado Tax Extension
desc: Colorado automatic, no form, 90% payment condition, 6 months. C.R.S. sect 39-22-608(2).

title: Connecticut Tax Extension
desc: Connecticut Form CT-1040 EXT unless no tax owed with federal extension. Conn. Agencies Regs. sect 12-723-1.

title: Delaware Tax Extension
desc: Delaware Form PIT-EXT required, not automatic, 6 months. 30 Del. C. sect 511.

title: Hawaii Tax Extension
desc: Hawaii automatic, no form, 6 months, properly estimated tax must be paid. Haw. Code R. sect 18-235-98.

title: Idaho Tax Extension
desc: Idaho 80%/100% payment condition, 6 months, no form. Idaho Code sect 63-3033.

title: Indiana Tax Extension
desc: Indiana automatic with federal extension, 90% payment rule. IC 6-8.1-6-1.

title: Iowa Tax Extension
desc: Iowa automatic, no form, 90% payment condition, 6 months. Iowa Code sect 422.21.

title: Kansas Tax Extension
desc: Kansas automatic with federal extension attached, 90% payment rule. K.S.A. sect 79-3221.

title: Kentucky Tax Extension
desc: Kentucky automatic with federal extension, 6 months (12 abroad). 103 KAR 15:050.

title: Louisiana Tax Extension
desc: Louisiana automatic, no form, 6 months. La. R.S. sect 47:103.

title: Maine Tax Extension
desc: Maine automatic with federal extension, equivalent period. 36 M.R.S. sect 5231.

title: Alaska Tax Extension
desc: No individual income tax; corporate return due 30 days after federal due date. AS 43.20.030.

title: District of Columbia Tax Extension
desc: Form FR-127 required, not automatic, 6 months, full payment due with request.

title: Maryland Tax Extension
desc: Form 502E required unless no tax owed with federal extension attached. COMAR 03.04.02.14.

title: Minnesota Tax Extension
desc: Automatic to October 15, no form, 90% payment presumption. Minn. Stat. sect 289A.60.

title: Mississippi Tax Extension
desc: Automatic with federal extension attached, 6 months. Miss. Code Ann. sect 27-7-50.

title: Missouri Tax Extension
desc: Automatic with federal extension attached, up to 6 months. RSMo sect 143.551.

title: Montana Tax Extension
desc: Automatic, no form, 6 months. Mont. Code Ann. sect 15-30-2604.

title: Nebraska Tax Extension
desc: Federal extension operates automatically, up to 7 months. Neb. Rev. Stat. sect 77-2770.

title: Nevada Tax Extension
desc: No individual or corporate income tax. Nev. Const. art. 10, sect 1.

title: New Hampshire Tax Extension
desc: No individual income tax; Interest and Dividends Tax repealed effective 1-1-2025.

title: New Mexico Tax Extension
desc: Automatic with federal extension, capped at 6 months. N.M. Admin. Code sect 3.1.4.12.

title: North Dakota Tax Extension
desc: Automatic with federal extension recognized. N.D. Cent. Code sect 57-38-34.

title: Oklahoma Tax Extension
desc: Conditionally automatic, 90% payment rule, 6 months. 68 Okla. Stat. sect 216.

title: Rhode Island Tax Extension
desc: Conditionally automatic, 80% payment rule, 6 months. 280-RICR-20-55-2.6.

title: South Carolina Tax Extension
desc: Conditionally automatic, 6 months. S.C. Code sect 12-6-4980.

title: South Dakota Tax Extension
desc: No individual or general corporate income tax; Bank Franchise Tax only. SDCL ch. 10-43.

title: Tennessee Tax Extension
desc: No individual income tax since 2021; F&E Tax automatic 7 months. Tenn. Code Ann. sect 67-4-2015.

title: Utah Tax Extension
desc: Automatic, no form, 90% payment rule, 6 months. Utah Code Ann. sect 59-10-516.

title: Vermont Tax Extension
desc: Automatic, matches federal extension. 32 V.S.A. sect 5868.

title: West Virginia Tax Extension
desc: Automatic, matches federal, capped at 6 months. W. Va. Code St. R. sect 110-21-57.

title: Wisconsin Tax Extension
desc: Automatic with federal extension attached, 6 months. Wis. Stat. sect 71.03(8).

title: Wyoming Tax Extension
desc: No individual or corporate income tax. Wyo. Stat. Ann. tit. 39.

title: New York City Tax Extension Guide
desc: NYC individual tax rides on NY State Form IT-370; business GCT/UBT uses Form NYC-6, automatic 6 months.

title: Philadelphia Tax Extension Guide
desc: BIRT/NPT extension automatic, tied to federal extension, no separate city form. Wage Tax has no individual extension mechanism.

title: Pennsylvania Local Earned Income Tax (Act 32) Extension Guide
desc: No statutory extension provision exists anywhere in the Local Tax Enabling Act or its implementing regulation. Tax collection districts grant a filing extension as administrative practice only, tied to the federal/state extension.

title: Kentucky Local Occupational License Tax Extension Guide
desc: No statewide extension statute - roughly 200 Kentucky cities, counties, and school districts each set their own ordinance. Sampled ordinances show a common federal-extension-matching pattern, disclosed as a sample, not an exhaustive survey.

title: Denver Occupational Privilege Tax Extension Guide
desc: No extension mechanism exists for Denver's flat per-employee OPT - confirmed by direct text search of Denver's general tax booklet and every relevant Tax Guide topic.

title: Wilmington, Delaware Local Tax Extension Guide
desc: City of Wilmington Net Profits Tax (Form WCWT-6) honors the federal extension - a copy of the IRS extension must be filed with the Earned Income Tax Division by the original due date. Payment not extended; 5 percent one-time penalty plus 1.5 percent monthly interest on unpaid balances.

title: Maryland County Local Income Tax Extension Guide
desc: Maryland's 23 counties and Baltimore City do not administer a separate local income tax return or extension - local tax is computed on the same Form 502 as state tax, under the same automatic 6-month extension. Confirmed against Md. Code Ann., Tax-Gen. sect 10-823.

title: Colorado Other Cities OPT Extension Guide
desc: Aurora, Greenwood Village, Sheridan, and Glendale Occupational Privilege Tax - no extension mechanism found in any primary source checked for any of the four, matching Denver's OPT finding.

title: Ohio Municipalities Tax Extension Guide
desc: Covers all ~600 Ohio municipalities (RITA, CCA, self-administered) under one statewide statute, Ohio Rev. Code sect 718.05(G)(2).

title: Michigan Cities Tax Extension Guide
desc: Covers all ~24 Michigan cities with a city income tax, including Detroit, under MCL 141.664(1),(2).

title: Kansas City Missouri Tax Extension Guide
desc: Earnings tax, Form RD-112 (wage) / RD-111 (profits), automatic with timely filing and payment.

title: St. Louis Missouri Tax Extension Guide
desc: Earnings tax, Form E-8 (individual) / Form E-234 (business), payment due with request.

title: Portland Multnomah County Tax Extension Guide
desc: Combined business tax, Form EXT, 6 months, 90%/100% payment safe harbor.

title: San Francisco Tax Extension Guide
desc: Annual Business Tax Return extension request, not tied to federal extension, full payment due by original date.

title: Puerto Rico Tax Extension Guide
desc: Individual and business extensions both use Modelo SC 2644, automatic upon timely filing, typically 6 months. Payment not extended.

title: US Territories Tax Extension Guide
desc: US Virgin Islands (paper Form 4868 with VI Bureau of Internal Revenue), CNMI (dual-track mirror-code income tax plus 3 local taxes), and Guam (mirror-code Form 4868, filed with Guam DRT) confirmed/inferred from statute. American Samoa's dual-filing structure and US-return extension are confirmed; its own territorial-return extension mechanism remains an open item.

title: Master Extension Matrix
desc: Sortable table of every jurisdiction and tax type.

title: Extension Resources
desc: Official IRS resources (Free File, Direct Pay, EFTPS, Taxpayer Advocate Service) and IRS-authorized commercial e-file providers (TaxExtension.com, FileLater.com). No endorsements.

title: State Estate & Inheritance Tax Extensions
desc: 13 states + DC estate tax and 4 states inheritance tax extension rules - forms, automatic status, periods, and whether payment is also extended. Gift tax extensions are federal only.

title: FAQ
desc: Common extension questions answered.

title: Disclaimer
desc: Site disclaimer and terms.

title: Federal Excise Tax Extensions
desc: Form 720 and Form 2290 have no extension of time to file mechanism - confirmed against the Form 7004 eligible-forms table and each form current IRS instructions.

title: State Sales & Use Tax Extensions
desc: Does a state grant a sales tax filing extension? 9 states checked against primary sources - 8 have no general extension, Washington is the one confirmed exception.

title: Other Extensions - Payroll Tax and FBAR
desc: Federal payroll tax (Forms 941, 940) has no extension mechanism. FBAR (FinCEN 114) gets an automatic extension to October 15.

title: State PTE Elective Tax (PTET) Extensions
desc: How PTET/BAIT extensions work in 21 states - California, New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Illinois, Massachusetts, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Colorado, Maryland, Georgia, Arizona, Ohio, Virginia, South Carolina, Michigan, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Louisiana, Rhode Island, and Utah - some states need a separate PTET extension application, others ride on the entity's own return. Partial survey of the highest-volume PTET states.

title: Iowa School District / EMS Surtax Extension
desc: Iowa school district and EMS surtax have no separate return or extension - computed on IA 1040 line 19 and covered by the state automatic 90%-payment extension.

title: Oregon TriMet & Lane Transit District Self-Employment Tax Extension
desc: Form OR-TM has no separate extension form - it automatically follows a federal or Oregon individual income tax extension, though payment is still due by the original date.

title: Alabama Municipal Occupational Tax Extension
desc: No statewide statute - each Alabama city ordinance controls. Birmingham confirmed: a discretionary 30-day extension only, interest and penalty still accrue. Other AL cities disclosed as unconfirmed.
